title: pressure-recent-v4 behaviour check (gate 3 of card 008)
hypothesis: Moving the resource status last and omitting history in pages keeps the request prefix byte-stable without changing how the model behaves: acceptance does not regress versus v3 on the same tasks.

prerequisites.text: Gate 1: E1 fixtures pass for pressure-recent-v4 (no model calls)
Gate 2: cache_replay.py on run 4 and the card-007 trajectories: cacheable fraction above 85% at 80,000 bytes; page breaks equal pages at 40,000 and 20,000
run_pilot.py offers --arm pressure-recent-v4 (card 008 track; update runner.runner_version if it bumps)
S6a wiring for the mutation task file: run_pilot.py --tasks FILE.json IDS with materializer mutation-workspace-v2 (merged at eb3c160)
owner approval (then set status to approved)

gate3.note: 3 tasks from the card-007 evolution set, drawn by seed; pin ref.sha256 once the evolution set is written.

campaign.note: 6 runs x 24 attempts = 144 planned, plus room for 2 retried runs. No monetary cost (CLI on the subscription).

stop_rules.repeat_rule: No repeat stop in either arm (identical rule across arms, as card 007).
manual: A mechanism screen, not a utility claim: 3 pairs cannot show a small effect.

decision_rule: Adopt v4 as the incumbent context policy for S6 if gates 1 and 2 pass and gate 3 shows no acceptance regression (candidate wins or ties on 3 of 3 pairs). Otherwise keep v3 and record the result. Either way, report the replay numbers on the calibration trajectories.
notes: Gate 3 only. Gates 1 and 2 make no model calls and are prerequisites here, not runner invocations.
Per-run budgets match card 007 so v3 here is the same protocol as card 007's incumbent.
